decision.explanation: The question asks which sports teams Abel Thermeus represents or has represented. These are distinct teams in different sports (cricket and football), and both are explicitly stated. The candidate 'football team' (C2) is too generic and lacks specificity compared to the named team 'Motherwell F.C.', so it is not accepted.
